data.headline: AHT completes Las Vegas hotel sale for approximately $43.5 million

claims.text: AHT completed the sale of Embassy Suites Las Vegas for approximately $43.5 million in cash.

citation.quote: On September 25, 2026, Ashford Las Vegas LP, an indirect wholly owned subsidiary of Ashford Hospitality Trust, Inc. (the “Company”), completed the sale of the Embassy Suites Las Vegas located in Las Vegas, Nevada pursuant to an Agreement of Purchase and Sale, dated as of August 27, 2026, by and between Ashford Las Vegas LP, as seller, and 4315 Hospitality LLC, as purchaser, for approximately $43.5 million in cash, subject to customary pro-rations and adjustments.

claims.text: The 10-Q lists liabilities related to assets held for sale at 74,813 and 41,292.

citation.quote: Liabilities related to assets held for sale | 74,813 | 41,292

claims.text: The 10-K says issuance of preferred stock and operating-partnership units with distribution preferences could limit dividend distributions to common stockholders.

citation.quote: The issuance of these series of Preferred Stock and units together with any similar issuance in the future, given the dividend preference on such stock or units, could limit our ability to make a dividend distribution to our common stockholders.
